title: Direct work reserve bypasses graph-derived readiness
description: Evidence: runtime.reserveWork passes the raw work record to reservation policy; claimWork recomputes graph dependencies and derived readiness first. MCP exposes the direct reserve path. Impact: stale status=ready plus an open graph blocker can be reserved directly without force.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct reserve recomputes graph-derived readiness consistently with claim/next, with tests for stale ready status plus graph blocker.
